mapper.sql: id, title, summary, content, cover_img, author_id, category_id, status, visibility, is_top, view_count, publish_time, status_changed_time, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_blog WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.summary, b.content, b.cover_img, b.author_id, b.category_id, b.status, b.visibility, b.is_top, b.view_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user_like ul WHERE ul.target_type = 'blog' AND ul.target_id = b.id AND ul.status = 1 AND ul.deleted = 0) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_comment c WHERE c.blog_id = b.id AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0) AS comment_count, b.publish_time, b.status_changed_time, b.create_time, b.update_time, u.nickname as author_name, u.avatar as author_avatar, c.name as category_name FROM tb_blog b LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON b.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_blog SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.summary, b.content, b.cover_img, b.author_id, b.category_id, b.status, b.visibility, b.is_top, b.view_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user_like ul WHERE ul.target_type = 'blog' AND ul.target_id = b.id AND ul.status = 1 AND ul.deleted = 0) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_comment c WHERE c.blog_id = b.id AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0) AS comment_count, b.publish_time, b.status_changed_time, b.create_time, b.update_time, u.nickname as author_name, u.avatar as author_avatar, c.name as category_name FROM tb_blog b LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON b.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.status = 1 ORDER BY b.view_count DESC, like_count DESC, b.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.summary, b.content, b.cover_img, b.author_id, b.category_id, b.status, b.visibility, b.is_top, b.view_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user_like ul WHERE ul.target_type = 'blog' AND ul.target_id = b.id AND ul.status = 1 AND ul.deleted = 0) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_comment c WHERE c.blog_id = b.id AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0) AS comment_count, b.publish_time, b.status_changed_time, b.create_time, b.update_time, u.nickname as authorName, u.avatar as authorAvatar, cat.name as categoryName, ul.create_time as likeTime FROM tb_blog b INNER JOIN tb_user_like ul ON b.id = ul.target_id AND ul.target_type = 'blog' LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON b.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN tb_category cat ON b.category_id = cat.id WHERE ul.user_id = #{userId} AND ul.status = 1 AND b.status = 1 ORDER BY ul.create_time DESC
